title: Public knowledge base: expose the wiki, topics and trends in publications
description:
Goal: let any Papyrus publication expose its knowledge base to readers, read-only: entity (wiki) pages, topic pages, weekly trends, sparklines and emerging-cluster callouts. Built once in Papyrus core so any publication with a knowledge base can use it; the Shipped publication (AnthusAI/Shipped-web, board key SHIP) is the pilot and first consumer.

Principle: keep pages static and small; put churning numbers in versioned, public-safe JSON that a small client component reads. The only thing that must be a Papyrus Item is prose a human has approved.

Epics:
1. Read-only public wiki: accepted entities become editor-published pages (ties to the wiki lifecycle epic PPY-964472: no auto-written pages without a human gate).
2. Knowledge snapshot command and standard components (entity chip, sparkline, trend chart, graph neighbourhood, score readout).
3. Entity trends by weekly counting.
4. Emerging-cluster callouts.

Related boards:
- Collaborative steering initiative PPY-77bb3b (accounts, votes, moderation, comments, scheduled snapshots of live numbers).
- Biblicus epic blbs-d380cb (typed-entity extractor, weekly bins, cluster identity, extractor evaluation, cloud job runner).
- Shipped pilot: SHIP voting story ship-b35fa2 and design story ship-4a59a1.

Standing rule: each initiative carries a story "Document on the Papyrus marketing site" (see the story under this initiative). Existing marketing-site docs work: PPY-ab79ea, PPY-228e8d.

Out of scope for v1: public editing, history UI, discussion, contributor counts. Public graph claims (relations between named things) are only published after desk confirmation.
